messages:
alice: FYI incident INC-2026-0421 just spiked control-plane latency in eu-west-1. Deploybot auto-paused the canary for release v3.14.2 — holding remaining rollout windows. Need quick decision: rollback canary -> previous or keep paused and investigate.

deploy-bot: Deploy paused by automation at 2026-03-21T14:07:14Z
Reason: control-plane p95 latency > 2s in eu-west-1.
Canary status: 2/5 zones applied (25% traffic). Remaining windows blocked.
Actions: canary paused, rollback not applied. Use `/deploy rollback <release>` to rollback or `/deploy resume` to resume canary.

bob: linking dashboards — https://grafana.internal/r/INC-2026-0421  errors trending up in eu-west. Any idea if this is config or infra?

dave: control-plane CPU p99 at 97%, spike correlates with canary start time. Not seeing app-level N+1s; looks infra-level. 5xx ~3% in eu-west (baseline <0.2%).

carla: recommendation: rollback canary to v3.14.1 in eu-west and pin release slot for the rest of the rollout. We should reschedule remaining windows to Mon 09:00 UTC for a controlled retry after postmortem. Who can kick the rollback and update release notes?

erin: +1 to rollback. Product OK with pausing PRs. I'll ready a short release-note patch and tag #release-updates when PR is open.

alice: @deploy-bot please run rollback for canary in eu-west to v3.14.1. Keep the release slot locked for v3.14.2 and mark as 'pending investigation'.

deploy-bot: 
```
Running rollback: release=v3.14.2 -> target=v3.14.1
Scope: canary (eu-west-1 only)
Rolling back services: control-plane, router, kvcache-proxy
Progress: starting rollback steps
Step 1/4: routing shift -> OK
Step 2/4: instance replace -> OK
Step 3/4: health checks -> OK
Step 4/4: finalize -> OK
Result: canary now running v3.14.1 in eu-west-1. Canary slot remains locked for v3.14.2.
```

bob: thanks. we should also pin any db schema flags? Last schema migration was deferred in this release, so we're safe.

carla: Assigning tasks:
- dave: own postmortem + infra trace (ETA 2h)
- erin: open release-note PR (#2345) and add rollback note
- alice: lock release slot and add change-window reschedule (Mon 09:00 UTC)
- carla: update internal release calendar + notify sales/ops (short note)

ops-bot: Release slot locked: v3.14.2 (reason: incident hold). Next available window assigned: 2026-03-23T09:00:00Z.

dave: started tracing; control-plane kernel scheduler showed burst from rdma-controller during canary warm-up. Collecting logs now.

erin: PR #2345 opened — short note referencing INC-2026-0421 and rollback to v3.14.1. Link: https://git.internal/release-notes/pulls/2345

alice: OK team — rollback completed, slot locked, windows rescheduled. If postmortem clears, we'll re-run a staged canary on Mon 09:00 UTC with canary percentage ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> full. If infra instability persists, we'll cancel and backfill later.

carla: I'll draft a one-paragraph customer-facing blurb for release notes + internal sentry. Tagging @sales-ops in case we need comms.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback and slot-lock actions logged. Tickets: INC-2026-0421 (incident), REL-2026-031 (release slot).

alice: closing thread for now. Ping here when postmortem done or if metrics drop back to normal. :thumbsup:
